clinical_notes: NIH PubMed Central PMC12127709 (SUNY Downstate Medical Center): Frontal chest radiograph showing normal cardiac silhouette, clear bilateral lung fields, and no consolidation or atelectasis.

NIH PubMed Central PMC10405870 (Unity Hospital / Rochester Regional Health, NY): Frontal chest radiograph demonstrating dense right lower lobe (RLL) airspace consolidation consistent with acute lobar pneumonia.

NIH PubMed Central PMC7033380 (Chosun University Hospital Division of Cardiology): Chest radiograph demonstrating marked Stage III cardiomegaly with implanted permanent pacemaker generator and transvenous pacing leads.

NIH PubMed Central PMC5702695 (Cooper Medical School of Rowan University Trauma Center): Anteroposterior radiograph depicting severely displaced right clavicular fracture with inferior fragment displacement and partial pneumothorax.

NIH PubMed Central PMC7529567 (Thoracic Cancer / Mie Chuo Medical Center): Posteroanterior chest radiograph showing a 30 mm right upper lobe (RUL) pulmonary mass confirmed as invasive lung adenocarcinoma by transbronchial biopsy.

NIH NLM MedPix MPX1219 (Uniformed Services University): Historical radiograph submitted 9 months ago under Policy POL-UL-99102 (Claim PRIOR-CLM-8821) showing a large destructive left upper lobe apical mass.
